name: ActionDock Browser
description: AI-first Playwright browser gateway. Actions are intentionally precise so AI can call browser operations without guessing hidden op-specific params.

actions.title: Open
actions.description: Create or reuse a browser session and optionally navigate.

actions.title: Snapshot
actions.description: Read page text, refs, forms, frames, events, and suggestions.

actions.title: Press
actions.description: Press key globally or on target.

actions.title: Mouse Move
actions.description: Move mouse cursor to viewport coordinates.

actions.title: Find Click
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run click.

actions.title: Find Hover
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run hover.

actions.title: Find Focus
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run focus.

actions.title: Find Check
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run check.

actions.title: Find Uncheck
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run uncheck.

actions.title: Find Text
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and run text.

actions.title: Find Fill
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and fill text.

actions.title: Find Type
actions.description: Find by semantic locator and type text.

actions.title: Tab New
actions.description: Create and switch to a new tab.

actions.title: Tab Switch
actions.description: Operate a tab by id or label.

actions.title: Tab Close
actions.description: Operate a tab by id or label.

actions.title: Tab Bring To Front
actions.description: Operate a tab by id or label.

actions.title: Cookies Set
actions.description: Set cookie via flat fields or cookiesJson.

actions.title: HAR Start
actions.description: Start request capture for HAR export.

actions.title: HAR Stop
actions.description: Stop HAR capture and save artifact.

actions.title: Snapshot Diff
actions.description: Compare current snapshot against prior snapshot or saved JSON.

actions.title: Screenshot Diff
actions.description: Compare current screenshot against baseline image.

actions.title: Eval
actions.description: Run JavaScript on page or locator.

actions.title: Capabilities
actions.description: Return action schemas and workflow hints.
